One full day

1-Day Technical Try-Out

Hands-on time with sidemount, backmount doubles and closed-circuit rebreathers, all in a single guided day. The best way to feel what technical diving is really like before committing to a full course.

Try before you commit

Choosing a technical path is a big step, and every configuration feels different in the water. This day exists so you can experience them side by side, with expert guidance, and make an informed decision about where to invest your training.

There is no exam and no pressure. You will spend real time in each setup, ask every question you have and leave with a clear picture of what suits your body, your goals and the diving you want to do.

Good to know

  • Who it is forCertified divers curious about sidemount, technical or rebreather diving.
  • PrerequisiteOpen Water certification and comfort in the water. No prior tech experience needed.
  • GearAll specialist configurations are provided; bring your own mask and comfort items.

Find the setup that fits

The day is shaped around your goals. Try all three platforms or focus on the ones most relevant to the diving you want to do.

Sidemount

Feel the balance and freedom of independent side-mounted cylinders and dial in your trim.

Backmount doubles

Experience a manifolded twinset, valve reach and the stability of the classic tech platform.

Closed-circuit rebreathers

Experience breathing on a closed loop and feel what bubble-free diving is like.

KISS Sidewinder

mCCR

A sidemount closed-circuit rebreather — feel bubble-free diving with the flexibility of sidemount.

AP Inspiration

eCCR

An electronic closed-circuit rebreather — experience the backmount stability of a full-featured CCR.

How the day flows

Morning

1. Briefing & land drills

We cover goals, walk through each configuration on land and rig the gear together so nothing feels unfamiliar in the water.

Midday

2. In-water sessions

Confined and shallow open-water time trying each platform, focusing on trim, buoyancy and how each system handles.

Afternoon

3. Debrief & planning

We review video where possible, talk through what suited you and map a realistic path toward your certification goals.

Bring your curiosity, I will bring the gear.

Spaces are kept deliberately small so the day stays personal. Reach out with your certification level and preferred dates and I will confirm availability.

Questions before you book?

Tell me a little about your experience and what you are hoping to get out of the day, and I will help you plan.
